general.title: OMIX Volcano Plot
general.instructions:
Generate enhanced volcano plots from differential expression analysis results.

**Data Input:** Upload a file OR attach a DEG table data asset (RDS/CSV/TSV). When connected to an upstream workflow, leave the upload blank: the capsule finds exactly one CSV with 'DEG' in its filename under /data.
**Column Auto-Detection:** Leave column selection parameters blank for automatic detection.
**Example data:** Example DEG table is pre-loaded in /data/example_inputs/ for demo purposes.

datasets.name: DEG Table
datasets.description: Data asset containing differential expression results (supports RDS or CSV/TSV formats). For a connected upstream workflow, the durable input is one CSV whose filename contains 'DEG'. It must include gene names, p-values, and log2 fold changes.

categories.name: 📊 Basic Settings
categories.description: Essential parameters for volcano plot generation including input data and significance thresholds.

categories.name: 🏷️ Gene Labeling
categories.description: Control which genes are labeled on the plot and how they are selected.

categories.name: 📐 Plot Layout
categories.description: Customize plot dimensions, axis labels, and visual elements.

categories.name: 🎨 Color Customization
categories.description: Set custom colors for each quadrant of the volcano plot.

categories.name: ⚙️ Advanced Options
categories.description: Advanced axis capping, limits, and fine-tuning options.

parameters.name: DEG Table File (Optional)
parameters.description: Upload a differential expression table (CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS). If provided, this takes priority over the attached DEG Table data asset.

parameters.name: P-value Type
parameters.description: Choose 'adjusted' for FDR-corrected p-values (adjpval) or 'nominal' for uncorrected p-values (pval).

parameters.name: Gene ID Column (Optional)
parameters.description: Column name containing gene symbols or other feature IDs. Leave blank for the OMIX default: it prefers 'GeneName', then 'Gene Symbols', then common identifier names. Code Ocean cannot populate this control dynamically from an uploaded table; enter the exact column name here to override automatic detection.

parameters.name: Significance Column (Optional)
parameters.description: Column name for p-values or adjusted p-values. Leave blank for automatic detection based on P-value Type.

parameters.name: Log2 Fold Change Column (Optional)
parameters.description: Column name for log2 fold changes. Leave blank for automatic detection (looks for columns with 'log2FC', 'logFC', etc.).

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.description: Significance threshold for p-values (horizontal line on plot).

parameters.name: Log2 Fold Change Threshold
parameters.description: Fold change threshold for significance (vertical lines on plot).

parameters.name: Choose Feature to Label By
parameters.description: Sort genes by p-value or fold change before selecting top N to label.

parameters.name: Number of Features to Label
parameters.description: Number of top genes to label on the plot.

parameters.name: Label Only Custom List
parameters.description: If true, only genes in Custom Gene List will be labeled.

parameters.name: Custom Gene List
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of additional genes to label (e.g., STAT1, IRF7, MX1). Leave empty for none.

parameters.name: Label Only Passing Thresholds
parameters.description: If true, only label genes that pass both p-value and fold-change thresholds.

parameters.name: Label Size
parameters.description: Font size for gene labels.

parameters.name: Label Box Padding
parameters.description: Padding around each label box. Higher values = more space around labels, reducing overlap.

parameters.name: Label Repulsion Force
parameters.description: Repulsion force between overlapping labels. Higher values = stronger repulsion (0.5-3 typical range).

parameters.name: Label Max Overlaps
parameters.description: Maximum overlapping labels allowed. The default Inf preserves all selected labels; enter a finite number to permit automatic overlap suppression.

parameters.name: Use Custom Axis Labels
parameters.description: Enable custom axis labels defined below.

parameters.name: Custom Significance Label
parameters.description: Custom label for significance axis (requires 'Use Custom Axis Labels' enabled).

parameters.name: Custom Log Fold Change Label
parameters.description: Custom label for fold change axis (requires 'Use Custom Axis Labels' enabled).

parameters.name: Plot Title
parameters.description: Main title for the volcano plot.

parameters.name: Plot Subtitle
parameters.description: Optional subtitle for the plot. Leave empty to auto-generate from comparison name.

parameters.name: Y-axis Limit
parameters.description: Maximum Y-axis value (0 = automatic).

parameters.name: Use Auto Axis Capping
parameters.description: Automatically cap axis limits at specified quantile to reduce outlier impact.

parameters.name: Auto Capping Quantile
parameters.description: Quantile for auto-capping (0.5-1.0). Higher = less aggressive capping.

parameters.name: Symmetric X-axis
parameters.description: Use symmetric X-axis limits when auto-capping is enabled.

parameters.name: Custom X-axis Limits
parameters.description: Custom X-axis range (e.g., '5' for -5 to 5, or '-2,4' for -2 to 4). Leave empty for automatic.

parameters.name: X-axis Padding
parameters.description: Additional padding for X-axis limits.

parameters.name: Y-axis Padding
parameters.description: Additional padding for Y-axis limits.

parameters.name: Plot Title Size
parameters.description: Font size for the main plot title.

parameters.name: Axis Title Size
parameters.description: Font size for X and Y axis titles (e.g., 'log2 Fold Change', '-log10(p-value)').

parameters.name: Axis Tick Label Size
parameters.description: Font size for axis tick labels (the numbers on the axes).

parameters.name: Point Size
parameters.description: Size of points in the scatter plot.

parameters.name: Image Width (pixels)
parameters.description: Width of output image in pixels.

parameters.name: Image Height (pixels)
parameters.description: Height of output image in pixels.

parameters.name: Resolution (DPI)
parameters.description: Raster output resolution in dots per inch.

parameters.name: Not Significant Color
parameters.description: Color for non-significant points (ordered light to dark).

parameters.name: Fold Change Only Color
parameters.description: Color for points with fold change only (ordered light to dark).

parameters.name: Significant Only Color
parameters.description: Color for significant points with significance only (ordered light to dark).

parameters.name: Significant + Fold Change Color
parameters.description: Color for significant points with fold change (ordered light to dark).
